text: Consensus API can be embedded in a project to pull in up-to-date peer-reviewed citations
quote: Connect the Consensus API within your project to seamlessly integrate up-to-date peer-reviewed citations into your own custom workflow.

text: Citation Graph builds a full map of a paper's predecessors, successors, and co-cited works
quote: The Consensus Citation Graph turns a single seed paper into a complete map of the work that built it, the work it inspired, and the studies most often read alongside it.

text: Users can bulk-import thousands of papers into a library in one click for searching and gap analysis
quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.

text: Analyzes full text of papers, including paywalled content from major publishers, to surface relevant results
quote: Consensus analyzes the full text, including paywalled papers from major publishers, so you can find the most relevant papers.

text: Positioned as an AI-native alternative to Google Scholar with a more refined academic corpus
quote: Think of Consensus as an AI-native alternative to Google Scholar with a more-refined corpus.

text: Provides chained API functions like citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, and similar-paper lookup on top of its search engine
quote: Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.

text: Supports a search, screen, extract, and synthesize workflow for literature review with transparency
quote: Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.

text: Consensus Library turns an imported research library into a searchable, AI-powered workspace
quote: The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.

text: Searches over 200 million academic papers and uses LLMs to help find, understand, and synthesize literature
quote: It searches over 200 million academic papers and uses language models to help you find, understand, and synthesize the literature faster.

text: Every AI-generated response includes citations tracing back to the original source
quote: Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.

text: Supports importing papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS files into the library
quote: Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS

text: Offers an API to run automated searches, saving manual discovery time for teams
quote: Save your team hours of manual discovery research and run automated searches with our API to quickly and easily find the most relevant and reliable research.
